name: drvarada-skin-and-hair-center
title: Dr. Varada's Skin & Hair Center
description: A dermatology, trichology and aesthetics practice in Hyderabad, led by Dr. (Lt Col) Khagendra Varada — 45 years in practice, 25 of them in the Army Medical Corps. Vitiligo and psoriasis are the national specialisms. The voice is measured, plain and senior: write the way a consultant speaks in a consulting room, in short declarative sentences, with no hype. Lead with the patient's own words — a patient searches 'white patches on skin', not 'vitiligo management protocol'. Never claim a cure, guarantee a result, or use superlatives; Indian Medical Council advertising rules prohibit them. Every call to action ends at Practo, because the clinic team already runs on Practo and a parallel booking form would split their queue.

logo.notes: Symbol built from the client's own single-colour vector; geometry untouched, colour applied by layer. All wordmark type is outlined — no font dependency travels with the artwork. Icons come from a four-tier system (full / compact / micro / nano); pick the tier by the size the icon is DISPLAYED at, not the size of the file uploaded.

display.notes: Headings sit at 600, not 700 — at display sizes Gabarito's 700 turns shouty, which is wrong for a medical practice.

rules: Lead with the patient's own words, not the clinical term.
Every number must be attributable. '45 years in practice' is verifiable; 'thousands of happy patients' is not.
No cure claims, no guarantees, no superlatives, no named comparisons — Indian Medical Council advertising rules.
Before/after images require written patient consent.

conversion.rule: Every call to action terminates in Practo. There is no parallel booking form — the clinic team already runs on Practo and a second queue would break their workflow. Phone and WhatsApp sit below the Practo button, never beside it as an equal choice.
